description: Very little public data: a backup NWSL goalkeeper (2023-2025, retired January 2026), club and college press releases plus a short Wikipedia stub. Older sources use her maiden name (Bosselmann).

facts.fact: Drafted 28th overall by the Washington Spirit in the 2023 NWSL Draft.
Played four seasons as Gonzaga's goalkeeper (2019-2022).
West Coast Conference Goalkeeper of the Year (2022).
NWSL debut in the Spirit's 2024 season opener against Seattle.
Retired in January 2026 after three seasons with the Spirit.
